item.title: Episode 93 - An Attempt at Normalcy
item.itunes:title: Episode 93 - An Attempt at Normalcy
item.description:
On this week's episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang reluctantly leaves the city of Carantool and heads north towards the coastal city of Ançalén in hopes of reuniting with Valaren Ellyndor. What would they find when they get there, and would the party ever be able to move past these tragic few days? Find out right now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening! Follow us on Twitter @SneakPodcast, email us at mail@sneakpodcast.com, or leave us a review on iTunes! Thanks to our friends at https://battlebards.com for letting us use their sound effects, and also to Filmstro, the worlds first soundtrack creation studio. Check it out for yourself at https://filmstro.com.

item.title: Episode 96 - The Plane, Part 1
item.itunes:title: Episode 96 - The Plane, Part 1
item.description:
On this week's episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang finishes their business in Ançalén and meets with Valaren to travel between worlds and enter The Plane of the Damned. Hopeful to retrieve their fallen loved ones, they charge headfirst into certain dangers to charge the doorstep of Dath'Meros Rane. Would they find their friends? Would they survive the trip? Find out all that and more, right now!

item.description:

With the island on the brink of full-scale war, and the coastal city under siege, every decision they make can shape the future for Dûrhaven. What will they do next? Find out right now!
